package.description: Managing tasks is easy with AI on your side

en-US.description: Managing tasks is easy with AI on your side
en-US.longDescription: Dictate tasks and AI will note them down with the correct title, deadline, and reminder - plus, it summarizes them for you! It integrates with Gmail and Slack to capture tasks, converting them into actionable items. Focus on your own tasks in your private view and collaborate using Kanban Boards.
en-US.name: Ping
